verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's docs describe faceting as filters that return aggregated distribution counts, for example "Color: Red (12), Blue (8)", for building ecommerce-style navigation by brand, color, size and price range. The docs also cover a dedicated facet-search endpoint and InstantSearch UI integration. The early single-filter limitation reported by a community member describes an old version and does not contradict the current docs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that counts across all facets come back in the same single search request, detail on range or numeric facet stats, and independent hands-on corroboration of faceted navigation.
